codes.evidence_quote: Conceder los Premios Nacionales de la Cátedra de Flamencología... a la mejor labor desarrollada por los siguientes artistas, autores y entidades
codes.target: premiados por la Cátedra de Flamencología
codes.rationale: The awards rank and canonize artists, authors, entities, and activities through named prize categories such as honor, best work, and field-specific recognition.

codes.evidence_quote: El jurado encargado de conceder... lo integraron... Paco Cepero... director de la Cátedra de Flamencología... subdirector... secretario de la Cátedra y del jurado
codes.rationale: The text presents an expert/institutional jury as authorized to confer critical recognition and classify merit within flamenco.

derived_analysis.target: artists, authors, entities, and flamenco activities recognized by the Cátedra prizes

annotation_notes: Awards discourse clearly legitimates through hierarchy and expert recognition; routine sponsorship details were not coded.

codes.evidence_quote: la generosidad y capacidad organizativa de las Peñas malagueñas y de su afición de oro, salvaron un Congreso que pudo no celebrarse
codes.rationale: The local peñas and afición are credited as community actors whose commitment sustains a major flamenco congress.

codes.evidence_quote: elevar a una altura digna la seriedad de nuestros trabajos congresuales y hacernos pasar unos días inolvidables
codes.rationale: The chronicle evaluates the organization and seriousness of the congress positively rather than merely describing it.

possible_but_not_emitted.reason: The text uses rescue and continuity language for the congress, but the visible excerpt does not clearly frame flamenco as public heritage or safeguarding.

derived_analysis.target: Málaga peñas, local afición, and congress organization

annotation_notes: The article is truncated, but the visible passages provide sufficient evidence for community authority and evaluative praise.

codes.evidence_quote: La valentía de los miembros de la Peña Flamenca "Juan Breva"... ha servido para que el Congreso de las "Bodas de Plata" se llevara a cabo
codes.rationale: A peña is represented as the community institution whose courage and responsibility made the congress possible.

codes.evidence_quote: No fue tan brillante en los fandangos de Huelva... Daniel Casares evidenció... fuerza... soltura... dotes de composición... Buen final de fiesta el ofrecido por esta artista malagueña
codes.target: performances at the XXV Congreso de Arte Flamenco
codes.rationale: The article explicitly reviews multiple performances, balancing praise and criticism of artists and pieces.

codes.evidence_quote: evidenció su conocimiento de los personalismos malacitanos... soltura en el toque y dotes de composición... basando su arte en el taconeo... mostrando formas y giros propios
codes.rationale: The evaluations are grounded in aesthetic criteria such as stylistic knowledge, touch, composition, taconeo, forms, and giros.

possible_but_not_emitted.reason: The phrase about not cutting the trajectory of the congress suggests continuity, but it concerns event continuity rather than tradition authorizing proper flamenco.

annotation_notes: Performance criticism is the dominant discourse; community authority is present through the peña’s sustaining role.

codes.evidence_quote: aunque comprendí que distaba bastante de la Colección de Cantes Flamencos que, en 1881 publicó, con sentido científico, Antonio Machado y Alvarez, Demófilo
codes.rationale: The article assesses Villén's book by comparing it unfavorably with Demófilo's more scientifically framed collection.

codes.evidence_quote: Todas las citas y referencias que hacemos en nuestro artículo se han tomado de esta edición... Indagando en archivos y bibliotecas y repasando libros antiguos, pude encontrar, por fin, algunos datos
codes.target: bibliographic and archival reconstruction of Villén
codes.rationale: The author grounds the evaluation and reconstruction of Villén in scholarly bibliographic practice and archival authority.

possible_but_not_emitted.reason: The author calls himself a buen aficionado, but this self-description does not clearly grant community authority to judge or sustain flamenco.
The contrast with Demófilo's scientific collection authorizes scholarly value, but it does not make a direct authenticity claim about proper flamenco.

derived_analysis.target: Villén's Cancionero and its scholarly reconstruction

annotation_notes: The article is truncated; coding is limited to the visible bibliographic and evaluative passages.

codes.evidence_quote: Premio especial "Silverio", al cantaor o cantaora más completo... Premio Especial "Antonio", al bailaor o bailaora más completo... Premio especial "Ziryab", al guitarrista más completo
codes.target: Concurso Nacional de Arte Flamenco prize structure
codes.rationale: The contest creates formal hierarchies and exemplary categories by ranking completeness and naming prize divisions after canonical figures.

codes.evidence_quote: Obtuvo un magnífico triunfo, siendo de los artistas flamencos más aplaudidos... Calixto Sánchez... fue uno de los triunfadores
codes.target: performers at the Mairena del Alcor festival
codes.rationale: The noticiario evaluates festival performances through judgments of triumph, applause, and relative success.

codes.evidence_quote: Fernando de la Morena... nos enganchó con una soberana lección de compás y de cómo cantar gitano
codes.rationale: The praise applies flamenco aesthetic criteria, especially compás and a valued manner of singing, to define performance quality.

possible_but_not_emitted.reason: The phrase lección de compás is evaluative metaphor rather than a literal pedagogical authority or teaching relation.
The phrase cantar gitano carries identity language, but the visible passage uses it mainly as an aesthetic judgment rather than developed identity-group framing.

annotation_notes: Contest rules are coded only where they create hierarchy; ordinary administrative details were not coded.
